text:
andrew: deploybot flagged a staging publish error for redwood/worker:staging-20260321 — chunk checksum mismatch when pushing to eu-west-1 ECR.
andrew: logs show `ERROR: PutObject failed: checksum mismatch for chunk 3/12` and a 409 on manifest finalize.
deploy-bot: automated retry 1/3 failed; no further auto-retags will be attempted for this tag.
maya: ugh. is there a pinned digest we can fall back to for the canary?
sam: registry inspection — there's an orphaned manifest with the same tag but different digest (partial push). looks like CI lost connection mid-upload earlier.
andrew: can we pin the canary to the previous known-good digest sha256:abc123def456 and roll back the promotion?
release-czar: yes, prefer rollback to previous digest for staging canary so prod isn't affected. current change window open ~40m — we should decide quickly.
maya: +1 rollback to pinned digest. i'll update release notes and ping PMs.
sam: i can rebuild and republish a signed image, but it will take ~25m. note: deploybot will block automatic promote if provenance attestation is missing.
andrew: ops, is manual promote an option if signing isn't done in time?
ops-bot: manual promote supported: `deploybot promote --manual --tag redwood/worker@sha256:abc123def456 --reason "rollback: chunk checksum mismatch"` (requires an approvals entry in the release tracker).
maya: i'll add the approval and update the tracker. sam — if you republish, include cosign attestation so next promote is automatic.
sam: will do. i'll republish as `redwood/worker:staging-republish-20260321` and push attestation to the same ECR repo.
release-czar: decision: hold automated promotion, rollback canary to sha256:abc123def456 now, republish signed image in 30m and then manual promote once attestation present. sam, open a PR that updates the release manifest and release notes with rollback rationale.
andrew: logging this thread to #incidents and adding a short note in the release doc.
maya: done — release tracker updated and PMs notified.
sam: starting rebuild now, will post the new digest when complete.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. manual hold placed by release-czar; automated canary promotion suspended for tag redwood/worker:staging-20260321.
notes: decided to rollback canary to previous pinned digest and republish a signed image during the current change window. manual promote flow and approvals documented in thread.
